dct_description_sm: The data is comprised of quantitative data from the Inuit Health Survey conducted in Nunavik in 2004 and Nunatsiavut in 2007-08 pertaining to food security status. It is being examined in this project using a modeling approach to include qualitative data in order to develop a more integrated understanding of the factors influencing and determinants of Inuit household food security status.  It is being gathered and analysed to support informed decision-making in these two regions on this issue.

dct_title_s: Integrated modeling approach to understanding Inuit food security in Nunavik and Nunatsiavut
